claims.content: To exchange surveillance information on the Link 16 network by transmitting ballistic missile track/point data that is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

goal.raw_text: To exchange surveillance information on the Link 16 network by transmitting ballistic missile track/point data that is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages on the Link 16 network.
The C2 JU has detected data points via its local sensors that constitute ballistic missile surveillance tracks.
The C2 JU detects data points via its local sensors that constitute ballistic missile surveillance tracks.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU detects data points via its local sensors that constitute ballistic missile surveillance tracks.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines whether the data points being detected by its local sensors are currently reported on the interface and if there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.
To accomplish this, the C2 JU continuously correlates locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.
The C2 JU reports on all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks.
For these uncorrelated tracks, the C2 JU assumes R² in accordance with the R² rules specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.
The source of the ballistic missile track/point data is provided (Source TN).
The C2 JU time tags the ballistic missile data.
The C2 JU reports the position and associated parameters of the track valid at the time tagged.

Positional data for the ballistic missile tracks is reported in the Space Track message as X, Y, Z position in earth-centered, earth-fixed (ECF) Cartesian coordinates defined by the World Geodetic System-84 (WGS-84) Reference Frame.
Velocity of the ballistic missile tracks is reported as the rate of change along the X, Y, Z axis.

If covariance data is reported, it includes the best estimate of both tracking errors and statistical estimates of biases produced by emplacement errors, alignment errors, and other systematic errors.
Ballistic missile covariance data is transmitted with the root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix.

In the event of conflict between locally derived information and information reported on the interface, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.

If a system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track, it shall automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval.
The C2 JU has transmitted ballistic missile track/point data that is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.
Data correlation has been performed and dual designation has been minimized.
The proper rules for reporting a ballistic missile track/point have been followed.
Ballistic missile surveillance information has been exchanged among systems involved in joint operations to provide targeting and threat warning information.
